g.text: :Hitbox is enabled, e.g. when frame data dictates
[Hurtbox is already in the exclusion list]
The hit counter and exclusion list are reset
once the Hitbox is deactivated. The counter is
f.e. used by the player to calculate energy gain.
Add the Hurtbox to the exclusion list
Calculate the force direction from the
base force and the orientation of the Hitbox
The hit data is the payload of the
attack, e.g. the damage and force.
Again handled during the next state switch.
